html:
Ninh Binh is not only an attractive destination for tourists with Tam Coc-Bich Dong, Bai Dinh-Trang An… but when coming to Ninh Binh tourists also visit the mysterious Mua Cave.

Mua Cave is located in the Trang An scenic complex, surrounded by limestone mountains, exuding a unique beauty. The highlight of Mua Cave is Mua Mountain, especially the unique constructions.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ninh Binh, visit Mua Cave, to get here, visitors must go up to the top of Mua Mountain through the stairs on both sides of the stone blocks that are very eye-catching, with carvings of majestic dragons and phoenixes in the folk culture of the Vietnamese people.

When conquering 486 stone steps, visitors will reach the top of Chua Mountain, from here visitors can fully admire the beauty of Tam Coc, below are the rice fields in autumn, the rice fields become a golden color, the undulating mountains, the boats drifting downstream, creating a beautiful countryside picture.

The most beautiful time to travel to Mua Cave is in May and June when the rice is ripe, stretching out in a brilliant yellow color, the natural scenery appears like a harmonious picture.

Mua Cave possesses natural beauty, in the ripe rice season combined with the green of the surrounding mountains and forests, a cool blue stream, visitors can experience rowing a boat to admire the picture that nature has graciously bestowed upon Ninh Binh.

In addition to the top of Mua Mountain, Ninh Binh also offers visitors beautiful sightseeing spots such as: the image of a dragon behind the statue of Buddha Quan Am, a waterfall that pierces the sky, and is also one of the highest peaks in Ninh Binh, and is also one of the virtual living spots that many tourists come to take virtual life. It can be said that Mua Cave, a place with beautiful natural scenery, has now become a diverse eco-tourism destination, combined with mountain climbing experiences, will bring visitors new experiences.
